knownGaps.rationale: References resolve the same member from line/character-only cursor input, but rename refuses it unless the cursor includes an offset.
TemplateDiagnostics preserves selectedMemberName for the weak owner row, while AppDiagnostics preserves source/domain but drops that selected member identity.

Declare-view-model-member code action edits target a zero-length TypeScript insertion span but publish oldText as null, while other insertion edit plans publish empty-string oldText for all-or-nothing validation.

The then-branch local declaration value is materialized as a source-backed binding-context slot for usages, but cursor dispatch at the declaration value selects the built-in controller/bindable surface instead of the local slot, so references and rename miss the declaration locus.

The catch-branch local declaration value is materialized as a source-backed binding-context slot for usages, but cursor dispatch at the declaration value selects the built-in controller/bindable surface instead of the local slot, so references and rename miss the declaration locus.

Cursor info, references, and rename resolve nested $parent.hostTitle to the <let to-binding-context> binding-context slot, matching Aurelia Scope.getContext semantics, but the TypeScript overlay still reports TS2339 at that same token.
